picks.title: Roland Releases Melody Flip, an AI Melody-Generation Plug-In for DAWs
picks.excerpt: Roland shipped Melody Flip, an AI melody-generation plug-in built with Sony CSL that analyses a reference track's key, chords and mood, then offers ~300 creative palettes of new melodic ideas exportable as MIDI or audio.
picks.rationale: A real plug-in from a major hardware maker that drops MIDI straight into a session — the most directly actionable release in the pool.

picks.title: Suno pulls unapproved Mary J. Blige ad campaign citing deception
picks.excerpt: Suno pulled an ad campaign featuring Mary J. Blige after the singer said she never approved it, a reminder of how fast AI-music marketing can outrun artist consent.
picks.rationale: Freshest consent story of the week and a distinct event from the SOCAN suit already published on 09-05.

picks.title: Yamaha Creator Pass Review: A Subscription Built For The Budding Bedroom Producer
picks.excerpt: Attack reviews Yamaha's Creator Pass subscription, which bundles Output Arcade, LANDR sample access, AI-assisted mastering and a DAW bundle into a single monthly on-ramp for bedroom producers.
picks.rationale: Hands-on verdict on a bundled AI-mastering-plus-DAW subscription — a concrete buy/skip call for producers.

picks.title: The Three Tasks AI Can Take Off Every Artist's Plate
picks.excerpt: A practical breakdown of the three recurring jobs — metadata, pitch copy and content repurposing — that independent artists can hand to AI without giving up creative control.
picks.rationale: Names the specific admin jobs worth delegating today, so it changes an artist's workflow tomorrow rather than restating the AI debate.

picks.title: ElevenMusic Launches Composer 'Section-by-Section Song Editor'
picks.excerpt: ElevenLabs added Composer to ElevenMusic, a section-by-section song editor that lets creators regenerate a verse or chorus in place instead of rerolling a whole track.
picks.rationale: Moves generative music from slot-machine rerolls to targeted editing — the structural shift producers have been waiting for.
